links.outcome: PP-LLM accuracy on local historical MRI reports versus clinician reference standard
links.effect: Detected 99.8% (400/401) of ESFs; Gwet kappa 0.959 versus reference standard, comparable to two human readers (0.943, 0.934); 8 downgraded and 4 upgraded C-RADS classifications.
links.quote: The PP-LLM demonstrated almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (Gwet κ=0.959, 95% CI 0.937-0.981), comparable to two human readers (reader 1: κ=0.943; reader 2: κ=0.934), with no statistically significant difference in C-RADS classification accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Privacy-preserving (locally deployed) LLM to automate extraction and referral of incidental extraspinal findings in radiology reports

screen.reason: The study evaluates a privacy-preserving LLM on retrospective MRI spine reports to extract extraspinal findings and suggest referrals, testing model diagnostic/extraction accuracy rather than an organizational deployment practice.
